notes: Printer start accepted at 2026-10-22T23:42:25.190Z (01:42 on 23 October in Oslo). First observed RUNNING stage was Cooling chamber, about 392 minutes remaining, print error 0 and no HMS entries. First-layer deposition/adhesion is not yet verified; this is acceptance and startup evidence, not completed-quality evidence. The human explicitly authorized this ONE rotor II prototype despite rotor I not yet assembled, saying they were in bed and to PRINT THE NEXT ONE. Physical fit and rotor-I assembly acceptance remain unverified; the explicit sequence exception permits proceeding before that check and does not establish quality or function. Four new rotor II parts reuse the existing numbered ring II; no new numbered ring is printed. The blank cassette is non-electrical. Grey PLA on the right nozzle normal external spool; textured plate, bed leveling and flow calibration enabled, AMS and timelapse disabled. Four walls, 30% gyroid, 0.10 mm layers / 0.20 mm first layer, 8 mm outer brim and normal supports. Support removal, fine features, captive hardware, dimensional fit, retention, strength, ring-arm action and full assembly/operation remain unverified. Completed rotor-I combined run 27cd remains separate. Actual finish time, duration and filament usage are unknown.
